description: Updates a rate column. resource_category cannot be updated if the rate column is mapped to any rate tables (including deleted mappings).

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the company

parameters.name: rate_column_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the rate column

batch_job_id.description: When an expression update is queued for async recalculation, the background job id to poll until COMPLETED.

id.description: Unique identifier of the rate column

full_name.description: Full display name derived from name, rate category, and unit of measure

unit_of_measure.description: Unit of measure. Omitted entirely when the column has no unit of measure (e.g. material columns).

created_by.description: Login of the user who created the rate column

updated_by.description: Login of the user who last updated the rate column

in_use.description: Whether the rate column is mapped to any rate tables (including deleted mappings)

used_in_config.description: Whether the rate column is referenced by an active cost-calculator rate config

dependent_column_ids.description: Full transitive closure of upstream column IDs this column depends on. Empty for FLAT and FACTOR columns.

401.description: Although the HTTP standard specifies "unauthorized", semantically this response means "unauthenticated". That is, the client must authenticate itself to get the requested response.

403.description: The client does not have access rights to the content; that is, it is authenticated, but the server is refusing to give the requested resource. Unlike 401, the client's identity is known to the server.

404.description: The server can not find the requested resource. This can mean either the URL is not recognized, or the resource itself does not exist. Servers may also send this response instead of 403 to hide the existence of a resource from an unauthorized client.

422.description: The request was well-formed but was unable to be followed due to semantic errors.

name.description: Name of the rate column (max 200 characters)

unit_of_measure.description: Unit of measure ID (must exist in UOM master list). For MATERIAL columns it is always null and any supplied value is ignored; when switching a column away from MATERIAL to LABOR/EQUIPMENT a value i...

allow_project_overrides.description: Whether project overrides are allowed. Forced to true for MATERIAL FLAT columns and to false for CALCULATED columns (any resource category); the supplied value is ignored in those cases.
